title: The scale
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
source: lore/drift_wood/_SOURCE_BRIEF.md (Low Tide at Alsea Bay · deepening)
logline: Friday. The county clinic, the same lot as November. Wood goes in this time. The pup on the steel scale. The needle. 'For three legs, that's fine.' The strip draws the needle and nothing else.

panels.composition: The clinic lot. The Legacy. WOOD getting out with the pup under his arm. Going in. The strip goes in with him this time.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a thin man carrying a small three-legged puppy from a station wagon through a county clinic's door, no words
image.notes: November's strip stayed in the lot. This one goes in.

panels.composition: The steel scale. The pup on it, three legs, trembling. The VET: a white coat and a mouth.

balloons.text: For three legs, that's fine. He's — he's fine, Arthur. He came that way. Nothing's missing that he knows about.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a small trembling three-legged puppy on a steel scale with a vet visible only as a white coat and a speaking mouth
image.notes: The same vet's mouth as Oct 24. 'Arthur' again. 'He came that way' — the line the 2015 strip gives Wood.

panels.composition: The needle. Only the needle. No number. The 2009 panel, for a smaller dog.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, close-up of a scale's needle pointing at an unlabeled place, nothing else, no words

panels.composition: The Legacy. The pup on the passenger seat, in the blanket — the faded wool one, folded. Wood's hand on the gearshift. Nothing on his wrist yet.

characters.pose: on the seat, in the blanket

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, inside a station wagon, a small three-legged puppy sitting on a folded faded wool blanket on the passenger seat and a man's hand on the gearshift, no words
image.notes: The Carry's blanket, under the pup now.

art.line: quiet; water bleeding over the ink edge to suggest rain and fading light
art.palette: desaturated wet-on-wet: raw umber, Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw sienna
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for the Sundays

notes: 'For three legs, that's fine.' The needle. The blanket under the pup.
